ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels, primarily concentrated along the perimeter and central fluke region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central surfaces of both lobes. The left lobe displays dense dark mottling and a thick dark border along the leading edge. The right lobe is predominantly white with isolated dark pixel clusters and linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch calculated at approximately 120 degrees with a shallow vertical depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency jagged serrations with pixel amplitudes varying between 3-12 pixels. A significant geometric discontinuity (deep notch) is visible on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex sigmoidal trajectory; the trailing edge displays an upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel clusters (approx. 5-7 distinct units) are localized in the lower-central region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark diagonal linear disruption is visible on the right lobe; multiple shorter, unaligned linear marks are distributed across the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep jagged excision/trauma mark on the trailing edge of the left lobe. Yellow-orange barnacle clusters are visible at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced orange-hued biological encrustations (sessile organisms) localized at the extreme lateral tips of the fluke lobes.
